result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority, matching the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with the same `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id` clause the sales-rep query uses, and updated its Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`RegionManagerTest` (5 tests) and `TicketsPerProductTest` (2 tests) pass offline. Neither test checks the order of this list directly, so the example from the task (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is not covered by a test. Nothing is committed.
